scope: Pure SELECT observation of two clock_timestamp evaluations, not UPDATE or choice E2E reproduction
sql: WITH samples AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT clock_timestamp() AS first_at,clock_timestamp() AS second_at FROM generate_series(1,100000)) SELECT count(*)::int AS samples,count(*) FILTER (WHERE date_trunc('milliseconds',first_at)=date_trunc('milliseconds',second_at))::int AS same_millisecond,count(*) FILTER (WHERE date_trunc('milliseconds',first_at)<>date_trunc('milliseconds',second_at))::int AS different_millisecond,count(*) FILTER (WHERE first_at<>second_at)::int AS different_exact_timestamp FROM samples
